company.name: Middleware
company.shortDescription: Middleware provides a cloud observability platform that collects logs, metrics, traces, and events to monitor and troubleshoot applications.
company.description: Middleware provides a full-stack cloud observability platform that collects and organizes logs, metrics, traces, and events into a unified timeline. The system allows users to monitor applications and services, detect anomalies, and troubleshoot errors. It supports infrastructure monitoring, application performance tracking, and real user monitoring. The platform integrates AI-based tools for identifying unusual patterns and assisting with error analysis. Middleware consolidates observability data across cloud environments and offers features for reviewing and correlating events without manual aggregation.
